coveredContracts: Exact preview policy checked before rendering; failed motion preserves editing, source and recipe.
Hard invalid display sizing cannot become a successful fallback; measurement preflight stays useful.
Outgoing decoration retains committed content when current Plain input exceeds rich limits.
Every studio request gets the prepared global response headers.
Static no-JavaScript checks inherit fixture tracing and teardown.
Pure compilation, explicit single emission, package interfaces, local draft recovery and existing renderer defaults remain.
limitations: No new actual DevTools/current-stable OS qualification, physical device/Safari study or participant results.
Local server does not emulate Vercel routing, caching, deployment protection or CDN.
CI, npm publication and production outcomes are separate post-commit evidence.
Logs and traces are local; only this sanitized receipt is committed.
invalidators: Changed source, fixture, harness, package/lockfile bytes, generated artifact/configuration or governing contract invalidate the affected observation.
Browser/OS/toolchain changes require reconciliation before reusing runtime observations.
A newer contradictory result invalidates the affected pass. Hosted access/alias state must be refreshed at the exact deployment; local success does not establish it.
